dataimport.col.customers.active: yes or no (empty keeps the current value; new rows are active)
dataimport.col.customers.name: Customer name; stored in capital letters and must be unique
dataimport.col.customers.tin: Tax identification number (TIN); used to match existing customers
dataimport.col.materials.active: yes or no (empty keeps the current value; new rows are active)
dataimport.col.materials.code: Unique material code. Matches existing materials.
dataimport.col.materials.minLevel: Minimum stock level that triggers a low-stock alert
dataimport.col.materials.name: Material name (max 120 characters)
dataimport.col.materials.unit: Unit of measure, for example BAG, TRUCK, KG, LITER
dataimport.col.opening-materials.date: Date of the opening balance (not in the future, not after the first movement)
dataimport.col.opening-materials.quantit: Quantity on hand in the material's unit (up to 3 decimals)
dataimport.col.opening-materials.unitCos: Optional cost per unit in RWF
dataimport.col.opening-stock.date: Date of the opening balance (not in the future)
dataimport.col.opening-stock.quantity: Number of pieces on hand (whole number, 0 or more)
dataimport.col.products.active: yes or no (empty keeps the current value; new rows are active)
dataimport.col.products.code: Unique product code (capital letters, digits, - _ . /). Matches existing products.
dataimport.col.products.defaultPrice: Default selling price per unit in RWF
dataimport.col.products.dimensions: Size, for example 20 x 20 x 40 cm
dataimport.col.products.name: Product name (max 120 characters)
dataimport.col.sites.active: yes or no (empty keeps the current value; new rows are active)
dataimport.col.sites.code: Unique location code. Matches existing locations.
dataimport.col.sites.kind: SITE (production), HQ (head office) or WAREHOUSE; new rows default to SITE
dataimport.col.sites.name: Location name (max 120 characters)
dataimport.col.workers.active: yes or no (empty keeps the current value; new rows are active)
dataimport.col.workers.dailyWage: Daily wage in RWF (whole francs, more than 0)
dataimport.col.workers.momoName: Name registered on the MoMo account
dataimport.col.workers.momoNumber: MTN MoMo number for payment, for example 0788123456
dataimport.col.workers.nationalId: 16-digit national ID; used to match existing workers
dataimport.col.workers.site: Code of the site the worker belongs to, for example BTN-1
dataimport.conflict.customer_tin_name: TIN {tin} belongs to {other}, but this name belongs to another customer
dataimport.conflict.customer_tin_shared: Several customers share TIN {tin}; correct them in Master data first
dataimport.conflict.opening_after_first: Movements are recorded from {date}; the opening date cannot be later
dataimport.conflict.opening_exists: An opening balance of {qty} on {date} is already recorded for this location and item
dataimport.err.duplicate_column: Column {column} appears twice in the header
dataimport.err.has_errors: {count} row(s) have errors; nothing was imported
dataimport.err.missing_columns: Missing required column(s): {columns}. Download the template to see the expected header
dataimport.err.no_file: Choose a CSV file to upload
dataimport.err.no_rows: The file has a header row but no data rows
dataimport.err.not_csv: This is not a CSV text file. In Excel use Save As → CSV UTF-8
dataimport.err.too_many_rows: The file has more than {max} rows; split it into smaller files
dataimport.kind.customers.help: Customers matched by TIN, or by name when there is no TIN.
dataimport.kind.materials.help: Raw materials with code, name, unit and minimum level. Existing codes are updated.
dataimport.kind.opening-materials.help: Go-live raw-material balance per location and material, with optional unit cost.
dataimport.kind.opening-stock.help: Go-live finished-goods balance per location and product. One opening per location and product.
dataimport.kind.products.help: Finished products with code, name, unit and default price. Existing codes are updated.
dataimport.kind.sites.help: Production sites, head office and warehouses, matched by code.
dataimport.kind.workers.help: Casual workers matched by national ID, with site, daily wage and MoMo number.
dataimport.report.name: Name
dataimport.scope.site: You can only import data for your own site
dataimport.scope.worker_other_site: This worker belongs to another site
dataimport.v.code_format: Use capital letters, digits and - _ . / only (no spaces)
dataimport.v.date: Enter a date as DD/MM/YYYY or YYYY-MM-DD
dataimport.v.date_future: The date cannot be in the future
dataimport.v.duplicate_row: Same {key} as row {row} of this file
dataimport.v.money: Enter an amount in whole francs (RWF)
dataimport.v.national_id: National ID must be exactly 16 digits
dataimport.warn.deactivate_site: Deactivating this location hides it from new entries
dataimport.warn.latin1: The file was not saved as UTF-8 and was read as Windows-1252; check accented letters
dataimport.warn.momo_name: The MoMo account name does not match the worker's name
dataimport.warn.movements_before: Movements are already recorded from {date}, before this opening date
dataimport.warn.unit_unknown: Unit {unit} is not in the reference list of units
